statements.action_statement: GO-2026-5932 affects the deprecated golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp package tree, which has no fixed module release. The dhi-build frontend binary (docker-hardened-images/frontend ./cmd/dhi-build) includes golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp in its vendored build dependency graph (confirmed via go list -mod=vendor). No patched x/crypto release exists; remediation requires dropping openpgp from the frontend dependency graph (for example migrating consumers off x/crypto/openpgp).
